notes.text: Art. 65 annual loyalty award is paid at the hire anniversary after twenty years, but whole-month twelfths on non-disciplinary dismissal are not calculated on a termination run.

limitation.remediation: Calculate the full-month twelfths owed on non-disciplinary dismissal after entitlement.

notes.text: Split salary model: paga base (TimeSeries, 4 tranches May 2025/Jan 2026/Jan 2027/Jan 2028) + contingenza (frozen since July 1992 Protocol) + EDR (frozen EUR 10.33 since 1992).
Paga base May 2025 and Jan 2026 verified directly against published salary tables (ilccnl.it, kitech.it). Jan 2026 cross-checked across all 8 levels.

Jan 2027 and Jan 2028 paga base values confirmed from CCNL F015 renewal text (signed 2025-05-20): 4 tranches totalling +178 EUR at parametro 100 — May 2025 +75, Jan 2026 +35, Jan 2027 +35, Jan 2028 +33 (all at parametro 100 / L1). Parametro coefficients (L1=100, L2=115, L3=130, L4=139, L5=150, L6=180, L7=L7Q=205) applied proportionally; all 8 levels for all 4 periods cross-checked against Jan 2026 published figures (ilccnl.it, kitech.it); max deviation < 0.01 EUR. Source: confartigianatomarcatrevigiana.it citing F015 renewal.
Level 7Q has the same paga base as level 7, plus a fixed indennita di funzione of EUR 140.00/month (F015 Art. on Quadri, L. 190/1985). Modelled at order 8 (above level 7 order 7).

SENIORITY (Art. 56, testo integrale 20 maggio 2025, pp. 87-88): one scatto per biennio, at most five, for the impiegato only: level 7 16.73, 6 15.42, 5 12.55, 4 11.54, 3 10.78, 2 9.86 (7Q takes level 7). The operai accrue the Anzianità professionale edile of Art. 31 (p. 59) through the Fondo Unico APE, out of a territorial employer contribution: the engine pays them no scatti (excluded_categories operaio); a run that does not state the category is paid the scatti of the level.

For blue-collar workers in construction the Cassa Edile / EPR bilateral system provides additional accrual benefits (annual leave, Christmas bonus, seniority) that are separate from INPS seniority increments. These are not modelled; only the tabular seniority increments are implemented.

limitation.remediation: Pass the Cassa Edile contributions as a bilateral fund event, or model the Cassa Edile system.

notes.text: Apprenticeship standard professionalizzante Group 4 (Art. 7, Allegato D, renewal May 2025): 36 months / 6 semesters, destination level 4, 74/76/79/86/91/96% per semester, track 'standard_gruppo_4'. Source: ediltecnico.it citing F015 Allegato D.

INPS contribution rates from 2026-artigianato.json (artigianato sector). No Cassa Edile contribution substitution modelled in the INPS rate; employer Cassa Edile contributions are additional and are out of scope.

Layer 3: overtime is modelled (work_rules.time_supplements.overtime_bands); the Cassa Edile contributions, the premiums on ordinary night and holiday hours and the accruals managed bilaterally are out of scope (review of 2026-10-30)

Apprenticeship specialistico tracks (Allegato D, verbale 05/09/2023, Art. 9): 1 Sp (54m, livelli 4-5): 0-12=78%, 12-24=80%, 24-36=86%, 36-42=91%, 42-54=96%. 3 Sp (42m, livello 3): 0-12=78%, 12-24=80%, 24-36=86%, 36-42=91%. SIMPLIFICATION: 2 Sp (45m, livelli 3-4): last 8th sem.=3m (not 6m) to reach 45m (the exact boundary of the last period is not published in textual form by any secondary source; total duration of 45m is confirmed). Source: studiodalmaschio.it; fareapprendistato.it; cdltorino.it.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (artigianato) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles whether the 0.91 NASpI reduction of the artisan employers also applies to apprentices, nor the wage-integration contribution they owe (the FSBA is paid outside INPS). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of artigianato (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: CIGO: artisan builders are within the CIGO (D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-14, https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2015-09-14;148~art13!vig=2026-10-14, snapshot sha256 3f7019a244e01d36ac8e7c9e25bcf058c777c8ed758418ba261d83867672c46a)): 4.70% for the 'operai delle imprese dell'industria e artigianato edile' (lett. c) and 1.70% / 2.00% for their impiegati and quadri (lett. e-f). The artigianato table charges no CIGO, so the employer contributions of every worker are understated.

limitation.remediation: Model the CIGO of D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 by activity (edile, lapidei) apart from the tax sector, then remove this note.

notes.text: Art. 65: the twenty years of uninterrupted actual service leave out 'le anzianità convenzionali di carattere militare'; the engine counts the years from the start of the employment period, so the caller states a start that leaves them out. The anniversary of a hire on 29 February falls on 28 February in a common year (the text does not say).

limitation.remediation: State the years of actual service the premio counts as a worker fact.

source_document.title: Prevedi Nota informativa, Parte I, scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi' (in vigore dal 31/07/2026)

location.section: Contribuzione, nota 1), tabella CCNL EDILI - ARTIGIANATO, Impiegati - contributo contrattuale mensile; Operai - contributo contrattuale orario
location.quote: Il contributo contrattuale è un versamento mensile al Fondo Prevedi a carico del datore di lavoro, che varia da 10 a 20 euro per ogni mese intero di lavoro a seconda della qualifica e del livello di inquadramento del lavoratore edile (applicato anche per 13° e 14° mensilità). Contributo contrattuale in vigore dal 1 marzo 2020: 7 20,50; 6 18,00; 5 15,00; 4 13,90; 3 13,00; 2 11,50; 1 10,00; Apprendisti 10,00; Operai - contributo contrattuale orario: a) Operai di produzione Operaio di quinto livello 0,1027; Operaio di quarto livello 0,0952; Operaio specializzato 0,0890; Operaio qualificato 0,0788; Operaio comune 0,0685; c) Apprendisti 0,0700. * Il contributo complessivo di ciascun operaio è dato dal contributo orario moltiplicato per il numero di ore lavorate nel mese e viene arrotondato all'euro.

provenance.transformation: The monthly amounts of the impiegati by level and of the apprentices. Rules of the CNCE vademecum (Comunicazione 559, Allegato 1): for the impiegati 'il contributo contrattuale è versato per quattordici mensilità', 'riconosciuto in relazione ai ratei maturati per l'erogazione della 13° e della 14° mensilità', 'per intero se nel mese abbiano lavorato per almeno 15 giorni di calendario' (sickness, cassa integrazione and aspettativa non retribuita not counted), 'riproporzionato in relazione al ridotto orario di lavoro' for part time. Accordo of 4 July 2025: from October 2025 owed only when the employment lasts more than three months, unless the worker pays voluntary contributions. The operai pay the hourly amount of their level times the ordinary hours actually worked in the month (PeriodFacts.ordinary_hours_worked; the vademecum leaves out sickness, cassa integrazione and the other hours not worked), rounded to the euro, and nothing on the extra months; the custodi and the operai discontinui of the table are not levels of the bundle.
